verdict.rationale: CrewAI's core is an open-source framework with a public GitHub repo. It installs locally via `uv tool install crewai` and runs crews and flows from your own environment through the CLI. A community user reports running crews against local Ollama models. The managed AMP layer is described as extending that open-source framework, so the core does not depend on vendor infrastructure. Missing for 10: explicit license terms in the evidence, documentation for self-hosting production serving (the REST kickoff/status API and Crew Studio appear only as managed AMP features), and a dedicated self-hosted deployment guide.
